source_limit: Responses exposed bytecode, not verified Solidity/source ABI. Exact runtime paths reviewed with publisher ABI labels; no compiler equivalence or exhaustive symbolic execution. Explorer proxy_type=null/implementations=[] does not audit dependencies. Canonical RPC denied403 in current session; no live state or total obtained.

dependencies.limit: Immutable identity evidence only. Current grader, Safe signers, router/token/Treasury/Sleeve implementations and exact print ledger not recovered as same-block dependency closure.

accounting.fee_split: 0x2865..0x2c76: floor(fee/2) joins deferred NET budget; fee-floor(fee/2) remains vaultFees. Successful retry netSpentUsdg is attributed to current series even when prior pending is included; NetBought is not intrinsically series-tagged.
accounting.settlement: 0x2dd1..0x312d: convert long mark to raw USDG payout; reserve each side with ceil(outstanding*payout/1e18); prize=floor(vaultFees*1000/10000); return book-reserve+vaultFees-prize to House, zero book/vaultFees and call House settle. Prior prizeCarry and void treatment remain distinct.
accounting.rounding: Buy/sell curve paths contain conservative +/-1 integer adjustments and full-precision mulDiv; do not substitute frontend float curve for a quote. Redemption and House per-account claims floor; aggregate settlement liability reserves can differ from summed per-holder payout.
accounting.lazy_deposit: House0x10c7..0x1289 emits Deposited on matured queue synchronization without a new transfer. Counting every Deposited.usdg plus DepositQueued.usdg double-counts principal. Receipt order distinguishes direct idle deposit cash from synchronization.

print_methodology.definition: Treasury plus Reports Sleeve part-for-part, live Rialto one-share quotes with Reports fallback, NET market/index; earlier September25 exclusions/frozen House claim are historical only.

desk.limit: Main dispatcher only; selector match not itself semantic proof.

barred.authority: Public mapping getter; slot2 address key.
barred.accounting: Constructor-populated buy exclusion. No setter appears among the 33 matched dispatcher branches; not a general sell/redeem freeze.

buy.authority: Public, reentrancy guard; not halted/not barred; nonzero gross amount >= minTicket; current open series and before close; minTokensOut.
buy.accounting: Pulls gross USDG; mints selected outcome to caller; book grows by gross minus rounded fee and volume grows by gross. Post absolute skew increase is disallowed after lastCallTime; equality is not rejected by that comparison. Fee allocator also attempts deferred NET routing.

feesPaid.accounting: Accumulates both buy and sell fees; does not transfer with outcome tokens and is not a current holding or net revenue.

grade.authority: Current slot0 grader only; reentrancy guard; current open series, timestamp strictly greater than printTime.
grade.accounting: Records supplied print after numeric bounds using line and Treasury rfv dependency; compares print > line (tie is LOWER), binary long payout via settlement. Bounds do not reconstruct Sleeve/Reports, prove print truth or provide a dispute oracle.

grader.accounting: Current authority for grade; initial constructor identity is not current role evidence.

guess.authority: Public current-open-series path, before close; fee eligibility and one-guess flag.
guess.accounting: Prize-only guess state; not a wager or print challenge. Stores uint128 guess and monotonic guess order; upper input conversion/eligibility exact boundary should not be inferred from UI alone.

guessOf.accounting: Packed uint128 value, uint64 order, bool entered; no payout or token ownership implied.

halted.accounting: New-buy gate; sell/redeem branches do not read this flag.

markPrice.accounting: Computes current open-series curve mark, otherwise returns lastMarkWad. Not a historical quote, Treasury value or posted print.

minTicket.accounting: Minimum gross raw USDG for buy; not frontend dust minimum or minimum sell.

net.accounting: NET destination token of fee-funded router swap; not automatically burned.

open.authority: Immutable owner only, reentrancy guard; prior series and schedule guards.
open.accounting: Calls House fund, increments series, sets calendar/line/today fields, deploys distinct HIGHER/LOWER tokens. Funding is real USDG; virtual liquidity increases curve backing without a cash transfer. Treasury rfv threshold is not a full TrueRFV print.

owner.accounting: Authority for open/setGrader/setHalted/setMinTicket; no transferOwnership selector found. Safe implementation/signers still require separate evidence.

payPrize.authority: Public resolved-series path; unpaid prize and >= settledAt+86400.
payPrize.accounting: Marks prize paid once. Sends prize to proposed bestGuesser or rolls it into prizeCarry if none; rollover is not cash. This does not arbitrate market settlement.

pendingNetUsdg.accounting: Deferred fee-funded NET swap cash. Later successful fee allocator spends prior pending plus new portion; cross-series sum cannot be allocated by NetBought alone.

prizeCarry.accounting: Rolled unpaid prize accounting, overlapping reserved custody. Not extra income to add to balance.

proposeWinner.authority: Public resolved-series and unpaid-prize path; nominated account must have eligible stored guess.
proposeWinner.accounting: Accepts a guess not above print and improving stored eligible value, using earlier guess order for ties. Updates prize recipient only; cannot change printWad or outcome payout.

quoteBuy.authority: Public view of current open series.
quoteBuy.accounting: Returns modeled tokens and rounded fee using current book curve. Does not execute transfer or prove buy-specific halt/bar/account/slippage/clock acceptance; no series-ID argument.

quoteSell.authority: Public view of current open series.
quoteSell.accounting: Returns net USDG and rounded fee for burning selected tokens. Quote is not a fill or an account balance/allowance check; no series-ID argument.

redeem.authority: Public holder path, status resolved or voided, nonzero tokens; reentrancy guard.
redeem.accounting: Desk burns caller outcome without allowance then floor(tokens*payout/1e18) raw USDG, decrements reservedUsdg and transfers positive payout. LOWER uses 1e6-longPayoutUsdg. Tuple longOut/shortOut are not decremented here; token supply is remaining claims.

reservedUsdg.accounting: Aggregate retained settlement payouts/prizes; settlement rounds each side reserve upward, individual redemption rounds downward. Not disjoint from prizeCarry; rounding dust remains possible.

router.accounting: Fee allocator approves exact pending USDG and calls swapExactTokensForTokensSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with path USDG/NET, zero minOut, Sleeve recipient, current timestamp. Catch/defer is not a successful NET purchase.

sell.authority: Public, reentrancy guard; nonzero tokens, current open series and before close, minUsdgOut.
sell.accounting: Burns caller outcome through privileged Desk token call; reduces book by gross curve value, increments volume by gross sell value, transfers gross minus fee to caller. No buy halt/barred gate on this branch.

series.accounting: All 26 fields preserved. Book/exposure/fee/reserve/prize values differ; settled stored exposure is not remaining token supply. Zero tuple for unused ID is not a discovered active series.

seriesCount.accounting: Monotonic selected-Desk series sequence advanced by open; discover 1..count at pinned block, never historical seed inventory.

setGrader.accounting: Changes mutable grader immediately in this runtime branch; numeric print bounds remain separate from honest grading.

setHalted.accounting: Sets new-buy halt; not a global token-transfer or redemption pause.

setMinTicket.accounting: Updates raw USDG buy threshold. Nonzero buy guard still applies if threshold is zero.

sleeve.accounting: Recipient of fee-funded NET acquisition; does not prove Sleeve constituent valuation or beneficial ownership.

treasury.accounting: rfv() dependency for open/grade numeric checks; Treasury Core POL discrepancy remains unresolved and is not repaired by Predict accounting.

usdg.accounting: USDG cash token. Runtime assumes 1e6 payout unit; collector independently checks decimals, never assumes USD parity.

vault.accounting: House funding/settlement counterparty, not an ERC20 LP or outcome token.

void.authority: Permissionless current-open-series path after timestamp strictly greater than printTime+259200; reentrancy guard.
void.accounting: Settles using stored lastMarkWad, not a binary fresh winner; prize allocation rolls forward. Liveness remedy for ungraded market, not correction of a posted print.

activeAssets.accounting: Idle active accounting USDG; fund resets it to zero while sending capital to Desk. Zero while live does not imply no capital.

assetsOf.accounting: floor(sharesOf(account)*sharePriceWad()/1e18); sharesOf excludes matured notices but includes unmatured notices and eligible matured joins. Not liquid withdrawal cash.

cancelDeposit.authority: Caller account only after lazy sync; must still have pending principal.
cancelDeposit.accounting: Deletes unprocessed pending, subtracts totalPending, returns raw USDG. A matured deposit may synchronize to shares instead and cease to be cancellable.

cancelWithdraw.authority: Caller account only; nonzero unmatured notice after sync.
cancelWithdraw.accounting: Subtracts generation/series noticed tally, restores free internal shares, clears notice. No USDG payment.

claimWithdraw.authority: Caller account only; nonzero matured notice after sync.
claimWithdraw.accounting: Clears notice, floors shares*stored exitPrice/1e18, decrements totalClaimable, transfers positive USDG. Zero exit price can mean real zero payout; failed read is unknown.

deposit.authority: Public caller, wired and nonzero USDG; lazy account sync then transferFrom.
deposit.accounting: Idle: floor USDG*1e18/price shares, activeAssets and totalShares grow. Live: records current series pending and totalPending. Receipt must distinguish direct Deposited from lazy-sync Deposited emitted before new transfer.

desk.accounting: One-shot wired funding/settlement authority; current getter is not deployment signer evidence.

exitPriceWad.accounting: Struck exit raw USDG per1e18 shares; floor conversion to individual USDG, zero is distinct from unavailable.

fund.accounting: Sets live, increments House seriesCount, zeros activeAssets, sends that amount to Desk and emits Funded. Not a depositor cash inflow or trade.

generation.accounting: Incremented on zero struck exit price with remaining shares; old active share basis is wiped lazily. Does not replace the House address.

generationStartSeries.accounting: Reset series boundary used to exclude old pending joins; historical return calculations must not bridge it.

joinPriceWad.accounting: Join price stored at settle: struck exit price when nonzero, otherwise initial1e6 raw USDG scale; queue conversion floors to shares.

live.accounting: Controls deposit queue and struck price behavior, not Desk buy acceptance or wall-clock maturity.

noticeOf.accounting: Raw shares/series can persist until claim/cancel/sync; maturity is accounting predicate. Matured claims can survive a generation reset.

noticedShares.accounting: Exact key order is (generation,paidAtSeries): requestWithdraw writes slot8[currentGeneration][seriesCount+1]; settle consumes slot8[currentGeneration][seriesCount]. No account enumeration implied.

pendingOf.accounting: Raw USDG/series pending can remain after settlement, already counted via sharesOf; not additive to active shares after maturity.

requestWithdraw.authority: Caller account only, nonzero shares, available free balance after sync; same next-series notice can grow.
requestWithdraw.accounting: Moves free shares into notice for seriesCount+1 and generation keyed aggregate. sharesOf includes unmatured noticed shares; not an instant withdrawal.

seriesCount.accounting: Incremented by fund, not by settle. At idle current series is settled; live current series is not.

settle.accounting: Uses supplied returned USDG (does not pull tokens itself). exit=floor(returned*1e18/totalShares); removes noticed shares and floors aggregate exit reserve; active=returned-exitReserve. Handles zero-price reset; then converts totalPending at join price and clears aggregate pending. Receipt must prove prior Desk transfer.

sharePriceWad.accounting: Live uses prior join price or initial1e6; idle with shares uses floor(activeAssets*1e18/totalShares), otherwise initial1e6. Not a probability WAD or live equity mark.

sharesOf.accounting: Current-generation free shares plus unmatured noticed shares plus eligible settled pending conversion; excludes matured notice claims. Old active shares vanish across reset; no ERC20 transferability.

totalClaimable.accounting: Aggregate matured USDG claim reserve; aggregate floor versus per-account floor creates dust, not extra owner-attributed claims.

totalPending.accounting: Only not-yet-processed queued USDG; resets at settle even if individual raw pending records remain.

totalShares.accounting: Aggregate active share basis including unprocessed live notices, excluding shares removed at settlement; generation and rounding needed for owner sums.

usdg.accounting: USDG denomination, not proof of dollar parity; arithmetic initial price is1e6 raw.

wire.accounting: Locks Desk authority into packed slot0. No rewire or arbitrary sweep selector found in this exact dispatcher; not a full dependency audit.

wired.accounting: Indicates wire used; collector still compares actual Desk/USDG identities.
